newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-UDINESE TO FINE BRAZILIAN STRIKER AMOROSO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UDINESE TO FINE BRAZILIAN STRIKER AMOROSO.

text.p: Italian club Udinese said on Tuesday they would fine their Brazilian striker Marcio Amoroso for criticising coach Alberto Zaccheroni after he was substituted in a league match against Milan on Sunday.
The club had said on Monday that the player would not be punished but changed their minds 24 hours later.
"I am going to fine Amoroso and the club intends to make him pay it," Zaccheroni said after a training session.
Amoroso, who recently signed a new contract through to 2001 with the serie A club, was quoted in newspapers as saying that Zaccheroni did not like Brazilians.
"Since I have been here Zaccheroni has not liked me...It is not up to me to say that, if Zaccheroni stays, I want to leave. I have signed to 2001 and it's up to the club," he said.
Zaccheroni has also signed a new contract with Udinese, keeping him at the club for another season.
